quote.text: For truth is rightly named the daughter of time, not of authority.
quote.author: Francis Bacon, Novum Organum (1620), Book I, Aphorism LXXXIV — in the next sentence, we are “unable, as if bewitched, to become familiar with things themselves”

stories.kicker: The Atelier · electric fans and air circulators
stories.headline: The same fan body, two motors: one idles at thirty-nine watts, the other at two. The maker charges ten dollars more for the second
stories.dek: Almost no fan sold in Singapore publishes a comparable airflow figure. In Europe the law requires one, which is how you know the number exists and is being withheld.

stories.kicker: The Kit · a number about your head
stories.headline: Four hundred and ninety-nine dollars for twelve electrodes that score your concentration. The maker’s own science page cites no study
stories.dek: The Neurable One ships this month, to America only. Nobody outside the company has measured anything about it — and when two labs weighed its predecessor they came forty grams apart.

stories.headline: The race is five days away, the hospitality is gone, and the cheapest ticket on this page is twenty-eight dollars to watch Singapore play Paraguay
stories.dek: Every row below was re-checked against a venue, promoter or official seller. Two of our own standing entries were wrong and are corrected here.

stories.kicker: The World · one photographer, two capitals
stories.headline: A refinery burned south of Riyadh on Saturday. Sanaa says it did it; the coalition says nothing was hit. The only evidence either way is a French wire photograph
stories.dek: Aramco declined to comment and the energy ministry has said nothing. Markets closed before the fire started, so Monday is the first test of whether anyone believes it.

stories.kicker: Singapore · the five-minute train, in fifty-nine more days
stories.headline: Nothing on the Causeway link is unbuilt. What slipped is the signature on the safety certificate
stories.dek: Two governments moved the opening to end-February. On the authority’s own project page, forty-eight hours later, the train still opens this year.

stories.kicker: Technology · sovereign, for seventeen more days
stories.headline: Germany shipped a “sovereign” open-weight model on Reunification Day. Its maker had signed, a fortnight earlier, to merge into a Canadian company and trade under that company’s name
stories.dek: Seventy-eight billion parameters, Apache-licensed, trained on European soil — and no independent evaluation of it exists anywhere.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · a signature, and an absence
stories.headline: Hanhart has licensed Steve McQueen’s name for a chronograph. The watch the licence refers to has never been found
stories.dek: Three hundred pieces, sold out inside two days — and the same reference carries two maker-published prices twenty-six per cent apart.

stories.kicker: Screen & Sound · two films, one score
stories.headline: The critics gave them the same mark. One cost forty million dollars and took fifteen; the other cost a hundred and twenty-five and took three
stories.dek: Verity and Digger both scored forty-five on Metacritic on Friday. Audiences rated the one they skipped higher.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · the machine that never gets bored of you
stories.headline: Eight per cent of twelve- to fourteen-year-olds have asked a chatbot for help with their feelings. Among those who have, nearly two in three told nobody
stories.dek: The alarming figure everyone repeats and the sober one in the journals are measuring different things. Only one of them is about a twelve-year-old.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · nine of the eleven were real
stories.headline: The ten-year rose eleven basis points last week. Nine of them were real yield and two were inflation. That distinction decides whether bonds help you
stories.dek: A payroll print of twenty-nine thousand should have rallied the long end. It sold off instead — because the market is not pricing the Fed, it is charging rent.

stories.kicker: The Rabbit Hole · scale model kits, armour and aircraft
stories.headline: One database holds six hundred and ninety thousand kits. The single most-modelled object on earth is a Messerschmitt Bf 109, seven thousand and fifty-nine times
stories.dek: A box of grey plastic on branching frames, and a craft whose entire economy has been rearranged in eighteen months by a printer that resolves fourteen microns.

stories.kicker: Fitness · the number is not the number
stories.headline: Low fitness was the single biggest risk of death in 580,290 people. It still accounted for fewer deaths than blood pressure — and it was never measured as VO2 max
stories.dek: Risk to you and deaths in a country are different questions. Most of the longevity conversation answers the second with the first one’s number.

stories.kicker: Departures · the week the bookings opened
stories.headline: Japan’s weather agency has stopped looking at its mountains. A century of first-snow records ends, and this season’s dates cannot be compared with any before them
stories.dek: Also: Europe’s travel authorisation still has no start date and now costs nearly three times what it did, and Nagano’s monkey bus no longer takes cash.

stories.headline: 北上養老
stories.dek: Hong Kong has become the first rich jurisdiction to buy subsidised nursing-home beds inside another jurisdiction as a standing instrument of policy — and to pay its pensions, its medical vouchers and now its welfare cash across the border to meet them. It calls the arrangement choice. The queue it bypasses is twenty months long.
